topic: Unit 1: Measurement (Physical Quantities, SI Units, Prefixes, Vernier Callipers, Screw Gauge, Significant Figures)
activities: Measure thickness/diameter of solid cylinder with Vernier callipers and wire diameter with micrometer screw gauge; practice scientific notation and significant figures.
resources: Physics 9 PCTB (Unit 1), CANTAB Model Textbook (Unit 2), STBB Physics IX (Unit 1)

topic: Unit 2: Kinematics (Rest & Motion, Distance, Displacement, Speed, Velocity, Acceleration, Graphs & Free Fall)
activities: Plot and interpret distance-time and speed-time graphs; calculate gradient and area under speed-time graphs; solve free-fall problems using g = Δv/Δt.
resources: Physics 9 PCTB (Unit 2), PhET Moving Man Simulation, The Physics Classroom

topic: Unit 3: Dynamics (Mass & Weight, Contact & Non-Contact Forces, Fundamental Forces, Newton's Laws, Momentum, Friction, Circular Motion)
activities: Demonstrate inertia, verify F = ma and F = Δp/Δt, compare sliding and rolling friction, and analyse safety features (seatbelts, airbags, crumple zones).
resources: Physics 9 PCTB (Unit 3), PhET Forces and Motion, Heinemann Physics (Units 2 & 4)

topic: Unit 4: Turning Effect of Forces (Like & Unlike Parallel Forces, Torque, Principle of Moments, Centre of Gravity, Equilibrium & Stability)
activities: Verify the principle of moments using a balanced metre rule and suspended weights; determine centre of gravity of a plane lamina with a plumb line.
resources: Physics 9 PCTB (Unit 4), Charles Chew O-Level Physics (Unit 5), PhET Balancing Act

topic: Unit 5: Deformation of Solids (Elasticity, Hooke's Law F = kx, Spring Constant, Load–Extension Graphs & Limit of Proportionality)
activities: Practical activity: Measure extension of a helical spring under increasing loads, plot load–extension graph, and identify elastic limit and limit of proportionality.
resources: Cambridge IGCSE Physics (Unit 3), CANTAB Grade 9 (Unit 8), PhET Hooke's Law

topic: Unit 6: Work, Energy and Power (Work W = Fd, Kinetic & Gravitational Potential Energy, Conservation of Energy, Renewable Sources, Efficiency & Power)
activities: Solve numerical problems on E_k = ½mv², E_p = mgh, efficiency, and P = W/t; compare fossil fuels, hydroelectric, solar, wind, geothermal, nuclear, biomass, and tidal energy.
resources: Physics 9 PCTB (Unit 6), STBB Physics IX (Unit 8), PhET Energy Skate Park

topic: Unit 7: Pressure (Density ρ = m/V, Solid Pressure P = F/A, Atmospheric Pressure & Barometer, Hydrostatic Pressure P = ρgh, Pascal's Law & Hydraulic Lift)
activities: Measure density of regular and irregular solids using displacement method; solve numerical problems on P = F/A, P = ρgh, and hydraulic press F₁/A₁ = F₂/A₂.
resources: Physics 9 PCTB (Unit 7), Charles Chew (Unit 7), PhET Under Pressure

topic: Unit 8: Thermal Physics (Kinetic Molecular Theory, Internal Energy, Specific Heat Capacity, Latent Heat, Heating/Cooling Curves, Evaporation, Temperature Scales)
activities: Practical Paper III experiment: Plot temperature-time graph for ice converting to water and steam; convert between Celsius, Kelvin, and Fahrenheit scales.
resources: Physics 9 PCTB (Unit 8), John Avison (Unit 10), Practical Paper III Sample Guide

topic: Unit 9: Transfer of Thermal Energy (Conduction, Convection Currents, Thermal Radiation, Emitters & Absorbers, Vacuum Flask, Greenhouse Effect)
activities: Compare thermal conductivity of metals vs non-metals; investigate dull black vs shiny silver surfaces as emitters and absorbers of infrared radiation.
resources: Physics 9 PCTB (Unit 9), Cambridge IGCSE Physics (Unit 6), The Physics Classroom

topic: Unit 10: Nature of Science (Objectives of Physics, Sub-Fields of Physics, Hypothesis, Theory & Law, Scientific Method, Science, Technology & Engineering)
activities: Distinguish between scientific hypothesis, theory, and law with historical physics examples; classify real-world applications into science, technology, and engineering.
resources: CANTAB Grade 9 (Unit 1: Nature of Science), Britannica Scientific Method Guide
